arxiv-1910-03435.title: A Phase Model with Large Time Delayed Coupling This research is supported in part by the Natural Sciences and Engineering Research Council of Canada.
arxiv-1910-03435.creator: Isam Al-Darabsah, Sue Ann Campbell
arxiv-1910-03435.description: Abstract We consider two identical oscillators with weak, time delayed coupling. We start with a general system of delay differential equations then reduce it to a phase model. With the assumption of large time delay, the resulting phase model has an explicit delay and phase shift in the argument of the phases and connection function, respectively.

arxiv-2008-05359.title: LogoDet-3K: A Large-Scale Image Dataset for Logo Detection Thanks: J. Wang, S. Hou, S. Ma and Y. Zheng are School of Information Science and Engineering, Shandong Normal University, Shandong, 250358, China. Email: 2018020875@stu.sdnu.edu.cn, sujuanhou@sdnu.edu.cn, 201711030133@stu.sdnu.edu.cn, zheng
arxiv-2008-05359.creator: Jing Wang, Weiqing Min, Member, IEEE, Sujuan Hou, Member, IEEE, Shengnan Ma
arxiv-2008-05359.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Jing Wang, Weiqing Min, Member, IEEE, Sujuan Hou, Member, IEEE, Shengnan Ma. Logo detection has been gaining considerable attention because of its wide range of applications in the multimedia field, such as copyright infringement detection, brand visibility monitoring, and product brand management on social media. In this paper, we introduce LogoDet-3K, the largest logo detection dataset with full annotation, which has 3,000 logo categories, about 200,000 manually annotated logo objects and 158,652 images.

arxiv-2103-11279.title: Scalable Detection and Tracking of Geometric Extended Objects
arxiv-2103-11279.creator: Florian Meyer, Jason L. Williams
arxiv-2103-11279.description: Abstract Multiobject tracking provides situational awareness that enables new applications for modern convenience, public safety, and homeland security. This paper presents a factor graph formulation and a particle-based spa ( spa ) for scalable detection and tracking of extended objects.

arxiv-2106-15825.title: Notebook for PAN at CLEF 2021
arxiv-2106-15825.creator: Benedikt Boenninghoff, Robert M. Nickel, Dorothea Kolossa
arxiv-2106-15825.description: Abstract The PAN 2021 authorship verification (AV) challenge is part of a three-year strategy, moving from a cross-topic/closed-set AV task to a cross-topic/open-set AV task over a collection of fanfiction texts. In this work, we present a novel hybrid neural-probabilistic framework that is designed to tackle the challenges of the 2021 task.

arxiv-2205-01903.title: Self-Taught Metric Learning without Labels
arxiv-2205-01903.creator: Sungyeon Kim, Dongwon Kim, Minsu Cho, Suha Kwak, Dept. of CSE, POSTECH Graduate School of AI, POSTECH {sungyeon.kim, kdwon, mscho, suha.kwak}@postech.ac.kr http://cvlab.postech.ac.kr/research/STML/
arxiv-2205-01903.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Sungyeon Kim, Dongwon Kim, Minsu Cho, Suha Kwak, Dept. of CSE, POSTECH Graduate School of AI, POSTECH {sungyeon.kim, kdwon, mscho, suha.kwak}@postech.ac.kr http://cvlab.postech.ac.kr/research/STML/. We present a novel self-taught framework for unsupervised metric learning, which alternates between predicting class-equivalence relations between data through a moving average of an embedding model and learning the model with the predicted relations as pseudo labels.

arxiv-2205-11043.title: Coordinated Vehicle Platooning on Tree Networks: Efficient Time Discretization and Strengthened Formulation
arxiv-2205-11043.creator: Fengqiao Luo
arxiv-2205-11043.description: Abstract We consider the coordinated vehicle platooning problem on a tree network with time constraints while the routes of vehicles are given. The problem is to coordinate the departure time of each vehicle to enable platoon formation hence maximizing the total fuel saving.

arxiv-2301-05612.title: Companion weakly periodic matrices over finite and countable fields
arxiv-2301-05612.creator: Peter Danchev, Andrada Pojar
arxiv-2301-05612.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Peter Danchev, Andrada Pojar. We explore the situation where all companion n × n n\times n matrices over a field 𝔽 \mathbb{F} are weakly periodic of index of nilpotence 2 2 and prove that this can be happen uniquely when 𝔽 \mathbb{F} is a countable field of positive characteristic, which is an algebraic extension of its minimal simple (finite) subfield, with all subfields of order greater than n n .

arxiv-2305-02815.title: Variational Quantum Algorithms for Simulation of Lindblad Dynamics
arxiv-2305-02815.creator: Tasneem Watad, Netanel H. Lindner
arxiv-2305-02815.description: Abstract We introduce a variational hybrid classical-quantum algorithm to simulate the Lindblad master equation and its adjoint for time-evolving Markovian open quantum systems and quantum observables. Our method is based on a direct representation of density matrices and quantum observables as quantum superstates.

arxiv-2401-10792.title: Implications of the Weak Gravity Conjecture on Charge, Kinetic Mixing, the Photon Mass, and More
arxiv-2401-10792.creator: Fayez Abu-Ajamieh, Nobuchika Okada, Sudhir K. Vempati
arxiv-2401-10792.description: Abstract We investigate several phenomenological implications of the Weak Gravity Conjecture (WGC). We find that the WGC implies that the SM neutrinos must be electrically neutral, that the electric charge in the SM must be quantized, and that the photon must be massless.

arxiv-2410-04030.title: A comparison on constrain encoding methods for quantum approximate optimization algorithm Thanks: *These authors contributed to the work equally.
arxiv-2410-04030.creator: Yiwen Liu*, Qingyue Jiao*, Yidong Zhou, Zhiding Liang, Yiyu Shi, Ke Wan, Shangjie Guo
arxiv-2410-04030.description: Abstract . The Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA) represents a significant opportunity for practical quantum computing applications, particularly in the era before error correction is fully realized. This algorithm is especially relevant for addressing constraint satisfaction problems (CSPs), which are critical in various fields such as supply chain management, energy distribution, and financial modeling.

arxiv-2511-06186.title: Diagnosing and Resolving Android Applications Building Issues: An Empirical Study
arxiv-2511-06186.creator: Lakshmi Priya Bodepudi, Yutong Zhao, Ming Quan Fu, Yuanyuan Wu, Sen He, Yu Zhao
arxiv-2511-06186.description: Abstract . Building Android applications reliably remains a persistent challenge due to complex dependencies, diverse configurations, and the rapid evolution of the Android ecosystem. This study conducts an empirical analysis of 200 open-source Android projects written in Java and Kotlin to diagnose and resolve build failures.

arxiv-2602-22613.title: Spectrally Distilled Representations Aligned with Instruction-Augmented LLMs for Satellite Imagery
arxiv-2602-22613.creator: Minh Kha Do, Wei Xiang, Kang Han, Khoa Phan, Yi-Ping Phoebe Chen, Gaowen Liu, Ramana Rao Kompella

pmc-10625863.title: Artificial Intelligence in Breast Cancer Diagnosis and Personalized Medicine
pmc-10625863.creator: Jong Seok Ahn, Sangwon Shin, Su-A Yang, Eun Kyung Park, Ki Hwan Kim, Soo Ick Cho, Chan-Young Ock, Seokhwi Kim
pmc-10625863.description: Breast cancer is a significant cause of cancer-related mortality in women worldwide. Early and precise diagnosis is crucial, and clinical outcomes can be markedly enhanced. The rise of artificial intelligence (AI) has ushered in a new era, notably in image analysis, paving the way for major advancements in breast cancer diagnosis and individualized treatment regimens.

pmc-11420302.title: The primary systemic vasculitis associated optic neuritis: a retrospective analysis in a single center over 10 years
pmc-11420302.creator: Simeng Tang, Hang Zhou, Rui Li, Yu Wang, Hongyang Li, Yanli Hou
pmc-11420302.description: ObjectivesTo investigate the clinical and image characteristics of primary systemic vasculitis-associated optic neuritis patients.MethodsThis is a retrospective study. The patients clinically diagnosed with primary system vasculitis-induced optic neuritis were recruited from March 2013 to December 2023. All cases received orbital magnetic resonance imaging scans were analyzed. The ocular findings, systemic manifestations, laboratory data and prognosis were reviewed retrospectively.

pmc-11513848.title: Optimizing degassing for particle-reinforced Al composite: Advanced ultrasonic-assisted argon treatment and numerical simulation insights
pmc-11513848.creator: Jian Chen, Xinyuan Jin, Jiwei Geng, Xianhui Luo, Yugang Li, Peikang Xia, Xianfeng Li, Fangming Wang, Dong Chen, Mingliang Wang, Haowei Wang
pmc-11513848.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Hydrogen removal from particle-reinforced Al composite is critical for preventing porosities near particle clusters and improving comprehensive material properties. This study investigated the effects of different argon flow schemes and power ultrasound on bubble dispersion in water. Based on similarity theory, the optimal argon flow scheme for ultrasonic-assisted argon (UAA) treatment was identified and applied to TiB2/2024 Al composite to explore the degassing mechanism.

pmc-11948196.title: Impact of cognitive rehabilitation interventions on memory improvement in patients after stroke: A systematic review
pmc-11948196.creator: Rebecca Mathew, Komudi Sapru, Dhruv Nihal Gandhi, Tahoora Abdul Nasir Surve, Devina Pande, Anushri Parikh, Rebecca Bhairavdutt Sharma, Ravneet Kaur, Md Al Hasibuzzaman
pmc-11948196.description: BACKGROUNDCognitive impairment is a major cause of disability in patients who have suffered from a stroke, and cognitive rehabilitation interventions show promise for improving memory.AIMTo examine the effectiveness of virtual reality (VR) and non-VR (NVR) cognitive rehabilitation techniques for improving memory in patients after stroke.

pmc-12564346.title: Selective Paracrine Modulation of Stromal Cells: Wharton’s Jelly MSC Secretome Enhances Adipose-Derived MSC Functionality While Maintaining Dermal Fibroblast Quiescence
pmc-12564346.creator: Tanya Stoyanova, Lora Topalova, Stanimir Kyurkchiev, Regina Komsa-Penkova, Svetla Todinova, George Altankov, Wasim S Khan
pmc-12564346.description: Wharton’s jelly-derived mesenchymal stem cells (WJ-MSCs) secrete a rich array of paracrine factors including growth factors, cytokines, and extracellular vesicles that hold promises for regenerative medicine. This study evaluated the effects of WJ-MSC-derived secretome on adipose-derived mesenchymal stem cells (AD-MSCs) and human dermal fibroblasts (HDFs), focusing on their adhesion, spreading, proliferation, endogenous collagen secretion, and migration.

pmc-13354672.title: School-associated measles outbreak driven by vaccination gaps, sociocultural barriers, and delayed detection in Gomba District, Uganda 2025
pmc-13354672.creator: Sharon Namasambi, Richard Migisha, Vianney John Kigongo, Maria Nakabuye, Lilian Bulage, Benon Kwesiga, Yasiini Nuwamanya, Fred Nsubuga, Collins Ankunda, James Peter Eliku, Josephine Bwogi, Alex Riolexus Ario
pmc-13354672.description: BackgroundOn May 27, 2025 a measles outbreak was confirmed in Kabulasoke Subcounty, Gomba District, Uganda, following a suspected measles-related death. We investigated the outbreak to determine its magnitude, identify risk factors for transmission, estimate measles-rubella vaccination coverage (VC) and vaccine effectiveness (VE), and inform control measures.
